d:
Methi na khane walon ko bhi pasand aayegi ye bina tale Methi Aloo Kachori Air fryer mein khasta layers!
Sardiyon ka nashta: methi atte mein hi gundh di, andar masaledar aloo bhara, aur bina tale, bina steam, bina boil khasta kachori roll taiyar. Poonam Devnani ki Masala Kitchen ki ye recipe methi se bhaagne walon ko bhi pasand aayegi.
Methi Aloo Kachori: gehu ke atte mein methi gundhkar layered kachori
Aloo filling: besan bhunkar, bina pyaaz-lehsun ke
Roll ko cup banakar aloo bharne ka tarika
Air fryer 180 par kitne minute: soft/crispy
